text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped by roughly 40%. Most of that time went to prep and follow-up.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were more complete, so managers stopped chasing updates.

**3. Trust took work.** Some customers hesitated at first. Telling them up front and offering to pause recording solved it.

**4. Summaries aren't strategy.** The tool captured what was said, not what mattered. Reps still had to add judgment.

**5. Adoption followed coaching.** Teams that reviewed real call summaries together used the tool twice as often.

Our takeaway: AI note-takers work best as an assistant, not a replacement for listening.

What has your team learned from piloting AI tools?
